name: Feature Prediction Table Construction
definition: A compact data structure that maps the occupancy values of a voxel's context (neighboring voxels) to a predicted occupancy value for the target voxel, used to reduce redundancy before sparse encoding.
summary: Feature Prediction Table Construction builds lookup tables mapping local voxel contexts to predicted occupancy values, differing from Sparse Voxel Octrees by modeling contexts at full grid resolution with varying strides.
